Say it once. Without yelling. 🤫 (And both parents say it the same way.)

The old way: 6:30 wake up. 7:10 still in bed. 7:25 Mom is rushing, pushing toast into his hand, and the school drop-off ends in screaming: "Why don't you EVER listen?!" 😩

Rewind. ⏪ Dad's way: 6:50, he says it ONCE. "We leave at 7:25." Then he doesn't nag. At 7:25 they leave, ready or not. "My breakfast!" Micah missed it, and nobody had to yell. 🚗

Next day? 7:05 and Micah is dressed and eating breakfast. ✅

🚦 Try the traffic light: give one calm reminder with a clear time, then let the consequence do the talking. Don't turn every morning into a string of warnings.

"But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay." Matthew 5:37

Our Heavenly Father speaks clearly, and covers us with grace we didn't deserve. 🙏 And if your child is still dragging their feet, ask: is it defiance, or is it worry? ❤️

BravePath Kids is a Christ-centered 21-day journey for childhood anxiety, made for parents and kids to do together:
✨ Simple anxiety skills
📖 Scripture they can hold onto
🙏 Prayer
❤️ Love in action
Ages 4-6, 7-9 and 10-12.
